description: Builds the webinar on the connected WordPress site: it creates the campaign with the facts the session has collected — title, date, room type — and returns the registration and room links. Side effect: it creates real content on the host's site: a campaign with its registration page and its room. It answers within seconds with status `laeuft` and a progress card while the pages are still being built: show that card, then call wi_get_build_status about every 10 seconds until fertig is true. Do not call this tool a second time for the same webinar and do not write any text yourself. Needs `session_id`. Optional `args` overrides single fields (e.g. a different `start_date`).

args.description: the arguments for that ability, shaped by its input_schema.

language.description: The language the host writes in.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.
